title: Mapping General-Purpose AI Governance in Twenty AI Middle-Power Jurisdictions
abstract: arXiv:2608.19278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The most capable general-purpose AI (GPAI) models are mostly built in two jurisdictions, the United States and China, but the risks they carry land globally. Regionally advanced economies hosting no frontier developer, which we call AI middle-powers, are writing their own rules to govern GPAI. This paper investigates which GPAI-relevant provisions these AI middle-powers have enacted, mapping twenty jurisdictions including the European Union at the level of the individual provision, across four governance areas that trace the accountability chain for the model layer: systemic risk assessment, evaluation and verification, prohibitions with monitoring and detection, and serious incident reporting. Confirmed absence is recorded as data alongside positive provision. We find that jurisdictions converge on form, but diverge on force. translated_title: 二十个AI中等强国的通用人工智能治理映射
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19278v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：最强大的通用人工智能（GPAI）模型主要在美国和中国两个司法管辖区构建，但它们带来的风险却全球蔓延。区域经济发达但无前沿开发者总部所在地的司法管辖区，我们称之为AI中等强国，正在制定自己的规则来治理GPAI。本文调查了这些AI中等强国颁布了哪些与GPAI相关的条款，映射了包括欧盟在内的二十个司法管辖区，在单个条款层面，跨越四个治理领域，追踪模型层的问责链：系统性风险评估、评估与验证、带有监控和检测的禁止规定，以及严重事件报告。确认的缺失与积极条款一同作为数据记录。我们发现各司法管辖区在形式上趋同，但在力度上存在差异。十六个辖区至少涉及四个治理领域中的三个，但只有约五分之一的条款处于双...
tldr: 本文通过映射二十个AI中等强国在四个治理领域的条款，揭示了它们在通用人工智能治理形式上趋同但强制力上分化，多数辖区仅覆盖部分领域，存在显著治理缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper maps provisions across four governance areas in twenty AI middle-power jurisdictions, revealing convergence in form but divergence in force, with most covering only partial areas and significant governance gaps.
